description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - Amendment to the Colombo Port City (Development Control) Regulation No. 01 of 2023
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021. It specifically amends development control regulations related to land use planning, plot subdivision, and land use distribution percentages. The content focuses on legal/regulatory amendments to existing legislation, which falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters, including statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation.
